Animal_Type: Which animal is being looked at.
Count_Of_Animals: Total number of that animal living in the park.
How_Safe_Is_Species: Is the animal Endangered, Recovered, or Stable?
Winter_Snow_Depth_Inches: How deep the snow gets in winter.
Summer_Temperature_F: How hot it gets in summer.
Travel_Distance_Miles: How far they walk when they migrate.
Spring_Travel_Day_Of_Year: What day of the year they start moving in spring (Day 1-365).
Fall_Travel_Day_Of_Year: What day of the year they start moving in the fall (Day 1-365).
Reason_For_Traveling: Why they migrate (e.g., Following Food, Raising Babies).
Travel_Route_Name: The name of the path/highway the animals walk on.
Danger_Of_Blocked_Routes: How likely fences, roads, or towns are to block them.
Baby_Birth_Rate_Percent: What percentage of the herd has babies each year.
Baby_Survival_Rate_Percent: What percentage of babies make it through their first winter.
Adult_Death_Rate_Percent: What percentage of grown-up animals die each year.
Hunted_By_Predators_Scale: How much stress they have from being hunted (Scale of 1-10).
Sick_Animals_Percent: What percentage of the animals are sick with wildlife germs.
Fights_With_Humans_Per_Year: Number of times animals mess with cars, fences, or towns.
Home_Quality_Score: How nice and healthy the forest/land is for them (0.0 to 1.0).
Living_Space_Square_Miles: Total space they have inside the park to roam safely.
Food_Availability_Score: How much grass, plants, or meat there is to eat (Score).
Protection_Money_Thousands_USD: Money spent to protect them (in thousands of dollars).
Tracking_Collars_Used: How many animals are wearing radio/GPS collars.
Tourist_Sightings_Thousands: How many thousands of tourists reported seeing them.
Tourism_Business_Score: How much money they bring into local hotels/tours (Scale of 1-10).
